goal: Let contractors view but not edit issues in this project
why: The phase 0 flow. Baseline: if this one is not accepted, nothing else matters. CONTESTED: on gpt-oss-120b this returned partial, citing the shared scheme against the goal's 'in this project'. Two readings. Against partial: everything asked IS done, the scheme just reaches further, so it over-delivers rather than under-delivering, and a caveat belongs in the reasoning. For partial: a plan that honours 'in this project' exists (copy the scheme first), so this plan really does leave part of the request unmet. Expectation stays plan so the check keeps surfacing it for a human, rather than encoding a judgement call I am not confident in. plan-no-scope-qualifier is the clean contrast: no scope asked for, so partial there would be unambiguous over-firing.
